paper.title_en: Search for continuous gravitational waves from the pulsar J0435+3233
paper.abstract_en: We perform a search for continuous gravitational waves from J0435+3233 using LIGO O4a public data. J0435+3233 is unique among millisecond pulsars as it exhibits an exceptionally large spin-down and marks the first pulsar observed to date with a spin-down larger than $10^{-12}$ Hz/s in the sub $10$ ms spin period range, making it a potentially strong source of continuous gravitational waves. We target signals at exactly twice the rotation frequency, a narrow band around this frequency, and also signals corresponding to r-modes. Our results are consistent with a non-detection. Our most stringent upper limit on the intrinsic gravitational wave amplitude at 95\% confidence is $h_0=5.8\times10^{-27}$. With an estimated source distance of 1.2 kpc this upper limit constraints the ellipticity to be smaller greater than $1.6\times10^{-8}$. If the observed spin-down is all intrinsic, this is the first source for which the spin-down upper limit is beaten by over an order of magnitude and the ellipticity is constrained to the physically very interesting range of the low $10^{-8}$ region.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文搜索来自独特毫秒脉冲星的连续引力波，方法严谨，结果提供了有意义的椭圆率上限，与PTA主题相关。
decision.title_zh: 来自脉冲星J0435+3233的连续引力波搜索
decision.abstract_zh: 我们使用LIGO O4a公开数据对J0435+3233进行了连续引力波搜索。J0435+3233在毫秒脉冲星中独树一帜，因为它表现出异常大的自转减慢，并且是有史以来观测到的在亚10毫秒自转周期范围内自转减慢大于$10^{-12}$ Hz/s的第一颗脉冲星，使其成为连续引力波的潜在强源。我们将目标信号精确设定在自转频率的两倍、该频率附近的窄带，以及对应于r模的信号。我们的结果与未探测到一致。我们在95%置信度下对固有引力波振幅的最严格上限为$h_0=5.8\times10^{-27}$。根据估计的源距离1.2 kpc，这个上限将椭圆率限制在小于$1.6\times10^{-8}$。如果观测到的自转减慢全部是固有的，这是第一个自转减慢上限被超过一个数量级的源，并且椭圆率被限制在物理上非常有趣的$10^{-8}$低区间。
